premise: Dog thinks Sandpiper's running back and forth with the waves is a game, gets splashed, and learns the waves leave Sandpiper's snacks in the wet sand.
inspiration: The imitation fables (Aesop's ass who copied the lapdog) turned kind: copying a friend ends in a splash, a laugh and each one's own game.
lesson: Everyone has their own reasons, and their own fun.
learning: Sandpipers run after the waves to find tiny food in the wet sand.

en-US.title: Chasing the Waves
en-US.text: {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:go to shore} Sandpiper was running along the shore. {sandpiper:pulse} Down to the water… {sandpiper:go to shore another} back up again. Down… back! {dog:enter} Dog watched, {dog:face surprised} his head on one side. [excited] A game! {dog:go to shore} He bounded down to join in. Down to the water… {sfx:splash} SPLASH! A wave washed right over his paws. {dog:face surprised} {dog:live} Dog shook himself dry, shake, shake, shake. [laughs] It isn't a game, said Sandpiper. {sandpiper:face happy} Every wave leaves tiny things to eat, just where the water has been. {sandpiper:live hold} So I run in, peck, peck, peck, and run out before the next one comes! {dog:face happy} Oh, said Dog. So that's your snack. [short pause] Then he grinned, and fetched {ball:enter} his ball. {dog:go to ball} {dog:hop x2} [playfully] And THIS, said Dog, is my favourite thing. {ball:live} The ball spun round, red and yellow and blue and white. {dog:hearts}

es-ES.title: Persiguiendo las olas
es-ES.text: {sandpiper:enter} {sandpiper:go to shore} Correlimos corría por la orilla. {sandpiper:pulse} Hasta el agua… {sandpiper:go to shore another} y otra vez arriba. ¡Abajo… arriba! {dog:enter} Perro lo miraba, {dog:face surprised} con la cabeza ladeada. [excited] ¡Un juego! {dog:go to shore} Bajó dando brincos para jugar. Hasta el agua… {sfx:splash} ¡CHOF! Una ola le mojó las patas. {dog:face surprised} {dog:live} Perro se sacudió, sacude, sacude, sacude. [laughs] No es un juego, dijo Correlimos. {sandpiper:face happy} Cada ola deja cositas de comer justo donde ha pasado el agua. {sandpiper:live hold} ¡Así que entro corriendo, pico, pico, pico, y salgo antes de que llegue la siguiente! {dog:face happy} Ah, dijo Perro. Así que esa es tu merienda. [short pause] Entonces sonrió y fue a buscar {ball:enter} su pelota. {dog:go to ball} {dog:hop x2} [playfully] Y ESTO, dijo Perro, es lo que más me gusta. {ball:live} La pelota dio vueltas, roja, amarilla, azul y blanca. {dog:hearts}

splash.prompt: a small wave washing up over a dog's paws on wet sand, a light splash, realistic
